instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Precision metal fabrication shop specializing in CNC-machined aluminum and titanium components for aerospace and automotive Tier-1 suppliers. We run 12 CNC machining centers across two shifts, focusing on extremely tight tolerances required by defense and high-end auto clients. Currently implementing ISO 9001:2025 certification and evaluating robotic tending automation to improve throughput and reduce scrap rates.
answers.pastInitiatives: We launched a digital customer onboarding flow last quarter that reduced average onboarding time from 12 days to 5 days. This project involved developing custom CAD templates integrated with our ERP system, which streamlined the quoting process for complex components. Early NPS scores for new customers onboarded through this flow are 22 points higher than the legacy process.
answers.strategicGoals: Our board has set an ambitious revenue target of reaching €50M ARR within 5 years from our current base. This requires us to expand our addressable market, potentially pivot pricing models from one-time to recurring revenue, and build a repeatable enterprise sales motion. We need to identify the highest-leverage growth levers without overextending our cash runway.
answers.additionalContext: The primary competition comes from larger, established Tier-2 suppliers who offer consolidated solutions. Our immediate challenge is maintaining quality consistency while scaling production capacity to meet the demands of high-growth aerospace contracts.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

opportunities.title: Automated Quality Assurance (AQA) Integration
opportunities.rationale: Given the focus on precision and medium regulatory requirements, integrating machine vision/AI for in-line quality checks can immediately reduce scrap rates and improve compliance efficiency. This is a low-risk, high-impact incremental step that leverages existing hardware.

first_actions: Pilot computer vision system on one key machining cell
Consult with local regulatory experts regarding new component inspection standards
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce material scrap rate by 8% within Q3
milestones: Q1: System selection and proof-of-concept completion
Q2: Full integration testing on primary product line
Q3: Operational rollout of AQA pilot

opportunities.title: Digital Twin for Design Optimization
opportunities.rationale: To hit growth targets in a capital-intensive sector, we should pivot from purely physical fabrication to offering 'Design-to-Fabrication' as a service. A lightweight digital twin allows us to simulate material stresses and optimize manufacturing paths before cutting metal, potentially finding efficiencies or new product niches that competitors overlook.

first_actions: Hire/contract one specialized mechanical engineering consultant
Invest in basic simulation software licenses (low cost)
Define a single high-value component for initial 'Digital Twin' testing.
resources_needed: €30,000 for specialized software and consulting fees
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase design optimization cycle time by 30% while maintaining tolerance accuracy
milestones: Q1: Design of the first optimized component model
Q2: Validation against physical prototype results
Q4: Market introduction of 'Design-to-Fabricate' service offering

opportunities.title: Subscription-Based Component Stock Management
opportunities.rationale: To address cash flow constraints and move toward recurring revenue, we can introduce a component stocking service for common aerospace fasteners or brackets. This shifts the business model from pure transactional sales to predictable subscription/inventory management.

first_actions: Analyze top 10 components by volume and lead time
Develop a simple inventory tracking module in existing ERP
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 15% of total component sales via recurring inventory contracts by year end
milestones: Q1: Implementation of tracking module and service catalog definition
Q2: Pilot rollout with one major customer segment
Q3: Formal pricing structure for subscription services finalized

next_steps.action: Initiate feasibility study and resource allocation for the Digital Twin project.
Implement immediate process bottlenecks identified by the AQA pilot results.

key_weaknesses: Over-reliance on founder's personal technical expertise, limiting scalable R&D capacity.
Extreme sensitivity to cash flow due to under €500k revenue ceiling and constrained budget allocation.
Limited formal talent pipeline; high reliance on external contractors for specialized engineering tasks.
Inconsistent customer feedback loop management due to informal communication channels.
